title: Jennifer W NDEs 4462 NDE 4462
content: I was three years old. I was sitting in the back seat of my dad's car and he was driving down the road. I was just sitting there, minding my own business when these hands pulled my soul out of my body. I was high in the sky and Jesus was there next to me. Suddenly I heard this very deep, pulsating vibration, it was spooky, but somehow I sensed that God was somewhere out there. I told Jesus I didn't want to stay and talk, I needed to find the source of the vibration. Jesus wouldn't let me go and explore. Instead, He was telling me things. He said that the next several years of my life would be horrible. He was preparing me for what was coming up. He gave me advice. I don't remember anything He said, except pretty much that life would be Hell. My parents belonged to a cult and were also Mormon. I was tortured and abused beyond belief, and developed seizures. I was sitting in church with my mom, grandma and sisters and my eldest sister began kicking me. I felt intense anger and then had a seizure. My body flopped around on the chair and fell to the floor. My grandma and mother were embarrassed, thinking I was acting up. Suddenly, I found myself in a dark place and two beings of very white light, one male; one female came and held me in their arms. It was the first time in my life I had ever experienced love. They held me for a very long time. They told me that God is love, something I had no knowledge of. I feel like they were my true parents, my spiritual parents. I was so confused, what is this love, who is this God you are talking about. I didn't want to come back, they told me I had too. This experience was so special to me; it helped me throughout my life. My uncle was a sadist and tortured me, many times to the point of death. Once, the fear and pain were so intense and I went into the most beautiful realm of shapes and colors. It was unbelievable. I know that when children are being tortured, God is there with them. He takes their souls out of their bodies and takes them into the most beautiful realms anyone could imagine. God does not abandon abused and murdered children. He gives them more love than anyone would ever believe. The child only is allowed to feel a little bit of terror and then God embraces them and takes them to absolute beauty. Children are God's masterpiece. I think He loves them the most.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Pulled out of body while sitting in the back seat of her dad's car; reported being "high in the sky" next to Jesus.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Described "hands pulled my soul out of my body" and a "very deep, pulsating vibration" that was "spooky."

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Jesus was "there next to me" while she was "high in the sky."

environment.environment_other_detail: A "dark place"; later "the most beautiful realm of shapes and colors."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Multiple events described: at age 3 spontaneous soul separation while riding in a car; later seizure episode in church; later episodes during severe torture/abuse "many times to the point of death."

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Parents "belonged to a cult and were also Mormon."

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Deep pulsating vibration sensed; held by two white-light beings; realm of shapes and colors.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: One episode begins with OBE into the sky with Jesus and a vibration; another begins in a dark place with two beings of white light holding her; later includes entry into a beautiful realm of shapes and colors during torture.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Multiple distinct NDE-like episodes across years (1965-1967) including seizure-related and abuse-related events.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported "hands pulled my soul out of my body" at age 3 while riding in a car; a "very deep, pulsating vibration" that she wanted to find; Jesus prevented exploration and warned that the next years would be horrible. Later, two very white-light beings (male and female) held her and taught "God is love"; she felt they were her "true parents"/"spiritual parents." Also described God taking tortured children's souls into "the most beautiful realm of shapes and colors."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "these hands pulled my soul out of my body"; "I was high in the sky and Jesus was there next to me"; "a very deep, pulsating vibration"; "Suddenly, I found myself in a dark place and two beings of very white light, one male; one female came and held me in their arms"; "They told me that God is love"; "the most beautiful realm of shapes and colors."
